_comment: AI2 Router model failover chains (AISYSTEM plan 5e). Not public (data/). Change via /ai/eval allow-listed keys (approve, apply, revert). Perl lists in Util/ModelCatalog.pm are only the last-resort default when this file is missing or invalid. Seeded 2026-09-28 from @FREE_PREFERENCE minus slugs that are 404/absent on openrouter.ai/api/v1/models.
_hermes_comment: Oct 28 2026 (Shanta): when Super Grok is unavailable Hermes goes grok-4.7 -> paid openai/gpt-5.6-luna (ON PROBATION; only while OpenRouter day/week/month caps have room: paid steps are used below 60% of the day cap and 90% of the week/month caps) -> free north-mini LAST. qwen/qwen3-coder was dropped Oct 28 after the audit (1.7/10). Luna probation (trials.gpt_56_luna, probation=1): luna own spend counts toward the OpenRouter caps and is counted from its baseline in data/ai_trials/gpt_56_luna.state.json; at 10 sessions or $5 of its own spend the guard marks it stopped, alerts once, and luna leaves the chain (guards skip it, its sessions are blocked) until Shanta approves the audit (perl script/ai_trial.pl approve gpt_56_luna). hermes_emergency_chain is used only if every step is unusable. channel_caps_usd = cash cap per billing channel (supergrok is a quota, not cash; xai_direct 0 = off until a number is set).

hermes_daily_lock_cash._comment: OFF by default (Shanta's rule: grok only through Super Grok). Oct 26 2026 she asked for the option: when true, the Super Grok daily lock tries x.ai direct grok, then OpenRouter grok, BEFORE paid qwen/qwen3-coder, then north-mini LAST, each only inside its channel_caps_usd. Do not turn on without her go-ahead. The chains above still reject grok on OpenRouter.

trials._comment: One-off model trials. NEVER a fallback: only script/ai_trial.pl (explicit trial runs) reads this. The model must not appear in any chain; grok, glm, deepseek v4-pro and Relace are rejected by the validator.

kimi_k27_code.approved_by: Shanta 2026-10-26 9:28 AM PT (answer to a card; from reserve, may go past the $50 OpenRouter month figure for this trial only)
kimi_k27_code.note: Oct 28 2026: spend is this trial model's OWN cost (Hermes state.db session_model_usage rows for the model since the baseline), not all OpenRouter spend. Frozen once the trial is stopped.

gpt_56_luna.approved_by: Shanta 2026-10-28 9:29 AM PT (answer to a card: put gpt-5.6-luna in the fallback chain as the first paid step after Super Grok, with a probation audit after about 10 sessions or $5). Replaces the earlier $3 / 6-task trial.
gpt_56_luna.note: PROBATION, not a free pass: luna is the paid chain step but only inside the OpenRouter caps, and its own spend counts toward them. Spend is this model's own cost (state.db session_model_usage since the baseline); a session with at least one call counts as a session. At 10 sessions or $5 the guard stops it (one alert), luna drops out of the chain and its sessions are blocked until Shanta approves the audit result; then run: perl script/ai_trial.pl approve gpt_56_luna (starts the next probation window). Provider routing here is the intent (OpenAI or Azure only, never Relace); Hermes has only a global provider_routing in config.yaml, so check the provider on luna's first calls.
